caption:
अरे बाप रे! रामयण के सेट पर लारा दत्ता के साथ हो गया खतरनाक कांड! 😱

फिल्म Ramayana में Kaikeyi का रोल निभाने वाली Lara Dutta ने हाल ही में Instagram पर एक BTS वीडियो शेयर किया है। 🎬

इस वीडियो में नजर आ रहा है कि वैनिटी वैन में उनकी टीम को उनकी कलाई में फंसा कंगन काटने के लिए hacksaw blade का इस्तेमाल करना पड़ा। 🪚

Lara Dutta ने मजाक में कैप्शन लिखा कि ऐसा दिखने के पीछे बहुत कुछ होता है, जिसमें कलाई लगभग कट जाना भी शामिल है! 😅

जबसे Ramayana का trailer आया था, तब से Kaikeyi के आधुनिक कपड़ों पर सोशल मीडिया पर काफी बहस छिड़ गई थी। 👗

Lara Dutta ने News18 से बातचीत में बताया कि उन्होंने निर्देशक Nitesh Tiwari से बात की थी कि क्या Kekaya राज्य की रानी के गहने अलग होने चाहिए? 🤔

लेकिन उन्होंने यह भी साफ किया कि तीनों राज्यों यानी Mithila, Ayodhya और Lanka की संस्कृतियों में अंतर दिखाने के लिए मानकीकरण अपनाने का फैसला हुआ था ताकि इतिहासवेत्ता और विशेषज्ञ सवाल न उठाएं। 📜

Nitesh Tiwari के निर्देशन में बनी और Namit Malhotra द्वारा निर्मित इस फिल्म में Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi और Yash अहम भूमिकाओं में हैं। 🌟

इस फिल्म ने रिलीज के आठ दिनों के भीतर ही दुनिया भर में 1,000 करोड़ रुपये का आंकड़ा पार कर लिया है, और इसका दूसरा भाग 2028 में रिलीज होने वाला है। 💰

तो दोस्तों, क्या आपके हिसाब से रामायण में आधुनिक कपड़ों और गहनों का इस्तेमाल सही था या नहीं? नीचे कमेंट्स में फटाफट बताओ! 👇

ctx.title: Lara Dutta says she almost had her wrist ‘sawn off’ on Ramayana set, shares BTS clip of stuck bracelet being cut off with hacksaw blade
ctx.summary: Lara Dutta shared a behind-the-scenes video from Ramayana showing her team cutting a bracelet off her wrist with a hacksaw blade.
ctx.text:
While the makers of Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana kept details about the film under wraps ahead of its release, the cast has been giving fans a glimpse into what went on behind the scenes following its release in theatres. Recently, Lara Dutta , who plays Kaikeyi in the film, shared a BTS video that left fans surprised. The clip showed how her team had to use a hacksaw blade to remove a bracelet that got stuck on her wrist during the shoot.
Taking to Instagram, Lara shared a carousel of pictures and videos offering a glimpse into her transformation into Kaikeyi. The post begins with the actor dressed in Kaikeyi's look, wearing elaborate traditional attire and heavy jewellery. Other pictures show her makeup and costume team working on her look.
However, one particular clip caught everyone's attention. It showed Lara sitting in her vanity van as a member of her team carefully used a hacksaw blade to cut through a bracelet stuck on her wrist. Sharing the video, Lara added a cheeky caption, which read, "To look like this, there's a whole lot of stuff that goes on behind the scenes!! Including almost having your wrist sawn off!!”
A post shared by Lara Dutta Bhupathi (@larabhupathi)
Lara's look as Kaikeyi became a subject of debate on social media ever since the film's trailer was released. Several viewers called her outfit too modern for the Treta Yuga. However, during a recent interaction with News18, Lara addressed the costume debate and explained the thought process behind the choices.
She said, “I know what the reason was for us to pick certain kinds of garments and the way that we wanted those to be depicted. It’s such a vast project that you’re undertaking and one nitpicked on such tiny things."
She added, “One of my first conversations with Nitesh sir was that if Kaikeyi came from the kingdom of Kekaya, wouldn’t her jewellery be very different from the other two queens? Wouldn’t she bring her own stree-dhan? But if you want to get into such minute details, then you’re opening up a Pandora’s box and then you would’ve historians and other experts coming up and saying, ‘Oh, how can this be shown and depicted?’ So, there was a standardisation that was decided to be adopted across all three kingdoms – Mithila, Ayodhya and Lanka – to differentiate between those cultures."
Directed by Nitesh Tiwari and produced by Namit Malhotra, Ramayana features Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita and Yash as Ravana. The first installment has crossed the ₹ 1,000 crore mark worldwide within eight days of its release. The second part of the two-part epic is scheduled to release in 2028.
